finding: Irrigated pivot pasture on the true right of a braided riverbed. A transmission corridor crosses the block (transmission 0 m) and the nearest mapped road is 1.8 km away. The disagreement is real and the transmission rank is the informative one here.

Coastal sand spit on a lagoon margin. Tagged landuse=meadow in OSM but it is bare gravel and dune with a formed track along it; not developable land at all. The road proxy ranks it first. This is the clearest example of why an OSM land-use polygon is not a parcel and why the aerial step cannot be skipped.

Irrigated cropping and centre-pivot country on the plains. Transmission crosses the block; the nearest mapped road is 0.9 km because rural roads here sit on a roughly 1 km grid. Plausible candidate; the road distance says nothing useful about connection.
